Name: Seed Information - Continued
Author: FlyingTNT
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15754]Seed Information[/url] by aedenthorn.

This mod shows information in shops when you hover over a purchasable seed. The information shown depends on the type of seed:

[list]
[*]All types of seed show whether there is enough time to plant left in the season, and which fertilizer is required if there isn't.
[*]All types of seed show their produce and the sell value of each quality (normal, silver, gold, and iridium).
[*]Flowers show honey sell value of each quality level.
[*]Coffee beans, hops, wheat, tea leaves, and flowers show their respective keg product (Coffee, Pale Ale, Beer, Green Tea, Mead) values of each quality level.
[*]Everything else shows pickle/jelly and juice/wine sell values of each quality level.
[*]Items that can be dehydrated will show their respective dehydrated products. There is a config option to display the price per input item.
[/list]
Prices and grow times should take into account any modifiers that exist like professions, etc.


[size=5]Config
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5]Technical[/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/FlyingTNT/StardewValleyMods[/url].
